gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0037d6ba6a4abb72.en: Can be obtained by processing Oil / Raw Oil / Light Oil
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0037d6ba6a4abb72.zh: 可以通过处理石油/原油/轻油获得

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0037d6ba6a4abb72.en: Heavy Oil requires an MV Distillery
You can also obtain it by reacting Sulfuric Acid with Ethanol
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0037d6ba6a4abb72.zh: 你也可以用硫酸和乙醇反应获得

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.006bbe4d312a2e2e.en: Later, you can make this more efficiently in a Chemical Reactor
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.006bbe4d312a2e2e.zh: 后面能用化反做，效率更高

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.010cf028448c17a9.en: Of course, voltages can be converted using Transformers. A Transformer can only convert between two adjacent voltage tiers, and has both step-up and step-down modes. In step-up mode, 1 voltage tier and 4x current are converted into 1 tier higher voltage and 1x current; step-down mode is the reverse.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.010cf028448c17a9.zh: 当然，电压之间可以通过变压器转换。变压器只能在两个相邻的电压层之间转换，同时有升压和降压模式。升压模式下，电压和4x电流将被转换为高一级电压和1x电流，降压模式就是反过来。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.010cf028448c17a9.en: There are four types of Transformers: Normal, Adjustable (2A), 4A, and 16A (Hi-Amp) Transformers. Normal is 1A<-->4A, 2A is 2A<-->8A, 4A is 4A<-->16A, and 16A is 16A<-->64A. The red side of a Transformer corresponds to low voltage, and the green side corresponds to high voltage.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.010cf028448c17a9.zh: 变压器分为四种：普通、进阶、高流和高能变压器。普通变压器为1A<-->4A，进阶变压器为2A<-->8A，高流变压器为4A<-->16A，高能变压器为16A<-->64A。变压器的红色面对应低压，绿色面对应高压。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.010cf028448c17a9.en: The multiblock Active Transformer unlocked in LuV supports mutual conversion between any voltage and any amperage, automatically stepping up or down, and can replace all regular Transformers in mid-to-late-game high-voltage, high-amperage setups.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.010cf028448c17a9.zh: LuV阶段解锁的多方块机器有源变压器可以支持任意电压与任意电流间的相互转换，自动升压/降压，在中后期高电压高电流环境下可以替代一切普通变压器。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.010cf028448c17a9.en: However, the real use of the Active Transformer is bending laser beams.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.010cf028448c17a9.zh: 但有源真正的用途是给激光拐弯。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.022dca5548f5df6a.en: A terminal capable of monitoring throughput across the entire ME Network
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.022dca5548f5df6a.zh: 可以监控整个ME网络吞吐量的终端

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.033de57f0d91698c.zh: 聚氯乙烯的性价比更高

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.048455ffc9bdc82a.en: Lets you obtain Rods and Screws more efficiently: 1 Ingot to 2 Rods, 1 Bolt to 1 Screw
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.048455ffc9bdc82a.zh: 让你更高效的获得杆和螺丝：一锭出两杆，一螺栓出一螺丝

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.050fd340224f7ab6.en: Check JEI on Raw Ores to view ore vein generation info
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.050fd340224f7ab6.zh: 在粗矿的JEI可查看矿脉生成信息

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.050fd340224f7ab6.en: See the Ore Generation chapter for detailed vein contents

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.050fd340224f7ab6.en: FTB Ultimine can vein-mine all ores

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.06d1abe453f52df1.en: The biochemical line produces various useful byproducts

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0718d5cede1587d1.en: Right-click this subpart with a wrench-type tool to toggle directly between Access and Supplier modes
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0718d5cede1587d1.zh: 使用扳手类工具右键该贴片可在访问端和供应端直接切换

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0718d5cede1587d1.en: When an Access end and a Supplier end are on two separate networks and placed against each other, the Access network can use available patterns in the Supplier network when requesting crafts; processing is executed in the Supplier network, and finished outputs are returned directly from the Supplier network to the Access network
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0718d5cede1587d1.zh: 访问端和供应端分别位于两个网络并相贴时，访问端网络可在下单时使用供应端网络内的可用样板，处理过程在供应端网络执行，产物会在完成处理时从供应端网络直接返回访问端网络

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0718d5cede1587d1.en: The Supplier network must have storage capacity
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0718d5cede1587d1.zh: 供应端网络应有存储部分

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.075d368e91231337.en: Before getting started, please read through all the prerequisite quests (located in the top-left corner).

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.07758fa2615b7559.en: Configuring it while disconnected from the network and connecting it afterward is recommended
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.07758fa2615b7559.zh: 建议断开网络写，写好再连接网络

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.07ac1b02299ef734.zh: 空手右键黑曜石可以去虚空世界，哭泣黑曜石则是超平坦世界，传送X,Z坐标为主世界坐标x100

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.07ac1b02299ef734.en: (Going too far from (0, ~, 0) can cause weird distance precision issues, so avoiding that is recommended)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.07ac1b02299ef734.zh: （离（0，~，0）太远会出现一些奇怪的距离现象，建议避免这种情况）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.07ac1b02299ef734.zh: 虚空和超平坦世界时间锁定，不会刷怪，不会下雨（但是仍然会被主世界的天气影响，如主世界下雨时虚空和超平坦会变阴天），限高511

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.07ac1b02299ef734.en: GT solar equipment does not work there
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.07ac1b02299ef734.zh: 在这里GT的太阳能设备无法工作

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.07d0d7005da4f446.zh: 你需要在高炉上放两个&7LV&r能源仓以将高炉升压到&bMV&r，这样它就可以&o&6运行&bMV&r&o&6的配方&r（电压间的功率换算关系例子如下：4A LV=1A MV，以此类推）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.07d0d7005da4f446.en: Aside from voltage, whether a recipe can run actually depends not on the coil itself, but on the heat capacity / temperature of the Electric Blast Furnace!
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.07d0d7005da4f446.zh: 除了电压之外，配方能否运作实际上并不取决于线圈，而是电力高炉的热容/温度！

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0877362a9ee36fb3.en: Later, you can make this using Silicon Wafers and Polyethylene
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0877362a9ee36fb3.zh: 后面可以用硅晶圆和聚乙烯制作

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0931ecbaad9252c7.en: Visit the World Exploration chapter to learn more
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0931ecbaad9252c7.zh: 前往探索世界章节了解更多

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.099798b0fda4463b.en: Likely your first cross-recipe parallel machine
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.099798b0fda4463b.zh: 可能是你的第一台跨配方并行机器

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.099798b0fda4463b.en: Quite powerful in the late game (exceeds the Dimensionally Transcendent Steam Oven in parallelism when using Naquadria-Taranium Coils)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.099798b0fda4463b.zh: 后期比较强力（当使用超能硅岩-塔兰线圈时并行数超过超维度蒸汽熔炉）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.099798b0fda4463b.en: Can use Laser Hatches, supports cross-recipe parallelism, and uses temperature-based parallelism where parallelism ×2 for every 900K increase in temperature
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.099798b0fda4463b.zh: 可以使用激光仓，支持跨配方并行，使用温度并行机制，温度每提升900K，并行数×2

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0badecf30ac0bac4.en: A multiblock structure checks whether sufficient power is provided before operating.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0badecf30ac0bac4.zh: 多方块结构在工作前时会检查是否提供了足够的电力。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0badecf30ac0bac4.en: The power a multiblock can consume is the sum of all its Energy Hatches.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0badecf30ac0bac4.zh: 多方块可消耗的电力是所有能源仓的和。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0badecf30ac0bac4.en: For example, if a recipe requires at least 120EU/t of power input to run, this can be achieved with two LV Energy Hatches: each hatch takes 2A of LV, requiring 4A of LV in total to reach a maximum power of 128EU/t. This is known as &bdual-hatch overclocking&r.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0badecf30ac0bac4.zh: 比如电力需要至少120EU/t的电力输入来运行其配方，这可以通过两个LV能源仓实现，每个仓需要2安培的LV，所以总共需要4安培的LV来达到最大128EU/t的电力。即&b双仓升压&r。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0badecf30ac0bac4.en: This allows running higher voltage tier recipes using a lower voltage tier. Note that this only works between adjacent voltage tiers—meaning &6you can only step up one tier&r, and you must use &btwo&r Energy Hatches.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0badecf30ac0bac4.zh: 这样可以实现低电压等级处理高电压等级配方，注意这只能在相邻电压中实现，即&6只能升压一次&r，且必须使用&b两个&r能源仓。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0bb44c475666b862.en: Can teleport through walls with a 2t cooldown (practically instant; configurable in the gtlcore config file)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0bb44c475666b862.zh: 可穿墙，CD为2t（相当于没有，也可以在gtlcore的配置文件中修改）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0bb44c475666b862.en: The space above a Travel Anchor must not be blocked, or you won't be able to teleport to it
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0bb44c475666b862.zh: 旅行锚上方不能有方块阻挡，否则将无法传送

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0bb44c475666b862.en: Right-click a Travel Anchor with a Stick to unlock it
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0bb44c475666b862.zh: 木棍右键可以解锁旅行锚

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0bb44c475666b862.en: With an empty main hand and a block in your off-hand, Right-Click an unlocked Travel Anchor to disguise it as the block in your off-hand
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0bb44c475666b862.zh: 主手什么都不拿，副手拿方块，对着未锁定的旅行锚右键可以将其伪装成副手方块的样子

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.en: In GregTech, electricity is transmitted in "packets". The size of each packet corresponds to its voltage tier.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.zh: 在格雷科技中，电以"数据包"形式传输。每个数据包的规模相当于其电压等级。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.en: Take an LV packet for example: this "packet" carries 32EU. Multiple blocks can produce these EU packets, and packets are only generated when a destination is reachable.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.zh: 以LV数据包为例,这个"数据包"将携带32EU，多个方块能够产生这些EU数据包，并且只有在能够访问目的地时才会产生数据包。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.en: Every tick (1/20 second, or 0.05 seconds), EU "packets" attempt to transfer from energy producers to consumers.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.zh: 每刻(1/20秒即0.05秒),EU"包"试图从能量生产者转移到消费者。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.en: These "packets" have two parameters: the voltage tier (V) determined by the producer's tier, and the amperage (A), which determines how much power can actually be transferred.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.zh: 这些"包"有两个参数:由生产者等级决定的电压等级(V)，以及电流(A)，这决定了实际可以传输多少功率。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.en: Energy is only transferred when a full amp "packet" can be received. You may notice your machines sitting just below full EU capacity - they only accept EU when missing at least 1A of input voltage.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.zh: 只有当完整的安培"包"可以被接收时，能量才会被转移。你可能会注意到你的机器正好低于满EU容量 - 它们只有在缺少至少1A的输入电压时才会接受EU。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.en: If a machine receives a voltage higher than its voltage tier, it will explode, but any excess amperage has no adverse effect because machines only draw what they need.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.zh: 如果一个机器接收到一个高于其电压等级的电压，它将爆炸，但任何多余的电流不会有不利影响，因为机器只按需消耗。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.en: Machine explosions normally destroy terrain as well, but this feature is disabled in this pack.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.zh: 机器爆炸通常也会破坏地形，但在本包中禁用了该功能。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.en: In short, energy is transferred in "packets": 32EU for LV, 128EU for MV... and so on. Due to cable loss, the energy actually received by a machine may be lower than the energy sent.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.zh: 总之,能量以"包"的形式传输,对于LV是32EU,对于MV是128EU...以此类推，由于电缆损耗，机器实际接收的能量可能会低于发送的能量。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.en: Machine energy input is limited by both voltage and amperage; therefore, an MV machine connected to an LV line with 1A input will never accept more than 32EU/t of power.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.zh: 机器能量输入受电压和电流限制，因此，一个连接到LV线路的MV机器，其输入电流为1A时，将永远不会接受超过32EU/t的功率。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.en: You can still run an MV machine on an LV line, but only if the recipe power is low enough, or if you have an MV battery in the machine's battery slot—when idle, the machine will only accept 1A, charging the battery at a maximum rate of 32EU/t.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cc922b821305906.zh: 你仍然可以在LV线路上运行MV机器，但只有当配方功率足够低，或者如果你有一个中压电池在机器的充电槽中，机器在空闲时只会接受1A，因此电池将以最大速率32EU/t充电。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0cf19cafb3355075.zh: 让你更加高效的获得导线和细导线

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0f4afde98cea87b1.zh: 只有你在世界创建的时候选择了 &b空岛&r

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.0f4afde98cea87b1.zh: 这样才是真的进入空岛模式了，如果你想试试常规模式把模式切换回去再新建一个存档就行

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.1f663a6c2dd1db60.en: When holding a Wrench and looking at a wrenchable block, a 3x3 grid appears on the block face:
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.1f663a6c2dd1db60.zh: 手持扳手对准可使用扳手的方块时，方块各面会显示出九宫格：

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.1f663a6c2dd1db60.en: The center section is largest, the edges are medium, and the corners are smallest.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.1f663a6c2dd1db60.zh: 其中中心的最多，棱其次，角最小。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.1f663a6c2dd1db60.en: Right-clicking the center of a machine face rotates the front face to that side (for non-GT machines with a front face) or sets the output face to that side (for GT machines); right-clicking an edge rotates the face toward that edge's direction; right-clicking a corner rotates the face to the opposite side. If right-clicking a non-directional non-GT machine, all of these actions dismantle the machine. Shift + Right-Clicking the center rotates the front face to that side (for all machines), and edges/corners behave the same way. For non-directional non-GT machines, this also dismantles the machine.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.1f663a6c2dd1db60.zh: 当右键机器面的中心时，则可将正面旋转到该面（仅有面区分的非GT机器）或将输出口调到该面（对于GT机器）；当右键棱时，则将面旋转到相应棱方向的面；右键角时，则将面旋转到右击面的对面。但如果右键的是无面的区分的非GT机器，则以上操作均拆卸下机器。当Shift右键面中心时，则可将正面旋转到该面（对于所有机器），其他对于棱和角一样。对于无面的区分的非GT机器，则以上操作均拆卸下机器。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.1f663a6c2dd1db60.en: Right-clicking the center of a pipe face does nothing; right-clicking an edge connects/disconnects the pipe in that edge's direction; right-clicking a corner connects/disconnects the pipe on the opposite side. Shift + Right-Clicking toggles whether input is blocked from that side.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.1f663a6c2dd1db60.zh: 右击管道的面的中心时，无变化；但右键棱则可连接/断开相应棱方向的管道；右键角则连接/断开对面方向的管道。Shift右键则可以控制是否输入相应面。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.1f663a6c2dd1db60.en: Right-clicking any non-front face of Logs, Hay Bales, Comparators, Repeaters, Pumpkins, Jack o'Lanterns, Pistons, Sticky Pistons, Droppers, Dispensers, Furnaces, Chests, Trapped Chests, Ender Chests, or Hoppers rotates them;
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.1f663a6c2dd1db60.zh: 右键原木、干草块、比较器、中继器、南瓜、南瓜灯、活塞、粘性活塞、投掷器、发射器、熔炉、箱子、陷阱箱、末影箱、漏斗的非正面时，可以转向；

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.1f663a6c2dd1db60.en: Right-clicking the front face of Crafting Tables, Bookshelves, Pumpkins, Jack o'Lanterns, Pistons, Sticky Pistons, Droppers, Dispensers, Furnaces, Chests, Trapped Chests, Ender Chests, or Hoppers dismantles them.

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2205c5f410b9c4db.en: The Electric Blast Furnace smelts items at a specific temperature—what does that affect? Every Electric Blast Furnace recipe has a specific base temperature; for example, Aluminium smelts at 1700K. If the temperature is not high enough, the recipe will not run; if the temperature is high enough, the duration will also be reduced.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2205c5f410b9c4db.zh: 电力高炉以一定的温度熔炼物品，有什么影响？每个电力高炉配方都有一个特定的基础温度，例如，铝在1700K熔炼，如果温度不够高，配方就不会执行，如果温度足够高，耗时还会减少。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2205c5f410b9c4db.en: Temperature mainly depends on the coil tier used, but in addition, starting from HV, each voltage tier adds 100K to the temperature. This means you can sometimes use a coil one tier lower combined with a high enough voltage to run recipes that seemingly require a higher-tier coil.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2205c5f410b9c4db.zh: 温度主要取决于所使用的线圈等级 ，但除此之外从HV开始，每个电压等级都会增加100K的温度。这意味着在某些时候可以用低一级的线圈加上足够高的电压来运行某些看似只能用更高一级的线圈的配方。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2d6bb32b642ae8ba.en: An Electric Motor is a device that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy. Its operation is based on electromagnetic induction: when current flows through the motor's coil, a force is generated in the magnetic field, causing the rotor to spin and drive a load. Electric Motors are widely used across industrial, commercial, and household appliances.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2d6bb32b642ae8ba.zh: 电动马达是一种将电能转换为机械能的装置。它的工作原理基于电磁感应，当电流通过电动机的线圈时，会在磁场中产生力，这个力使得电动机的转子旋转，从而驱动负载工作。电动马达广泛应用于各种工业、商业和家用电器中。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2d6bb32b642ae8ba.en: An Electric Piston is an electrically driven reciprocating device that converts the rotational motion of an electric motor into linear back-and-forth motion. Such devices are used in various applications like compressors, pneumatic actuators, and robot arms.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2d6bb32b642ae8ba.zh: 电力活塞是由电力驱动的往复运动装置，可以将电动机的旋转运动转换为直线往复运动。这样的装置可以用于各种应用，如压缩机、气动执行器、机械臂等。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2d6bb32b642ae8ba.en: A Robot Arm is a mechanical device that mimics the function of a human arm, typically consisting of a series of links and joints capable of complex movements including rotation, bending, and extension. Robot Arms can be programmed or remotely controlled to perform tasks such as handling, assembly, welding, spraying, measurement, and exploration.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2d6bb32b642ae8ba.zh: 机械臂是一种模仿人类手臂功能的机械装置，通常由一系列连杆和关节组成，能够进行一系列复杂的运动，包括旋转、弯曲和伸展。机械臂可以通过编程或远程控制来执行各种任务，如搬运、组装、焊接、喷涂、测量和探索等。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2d6bb32b642ae8ba.en: A Conveyor Module is a transport mechanism used to move materials or products from one place to another. It consists of one or more continuous belts rotating around two pulleys that serve as drive and support points. Conveyors can run horizontally, at an incline, or vertically to suit different transport needs.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.2d6bb32b642ae8ba.zh: 传送带是一种运输机械，用于将材料或产品从一个地点搬运到另一个地点。它由一个或多个连续的带状结构组成，围绕两个滚筒旋转，这些滚筒作为驱动和支撑点。传送带可以水平运行，也可以倾斜或垂直运行，以适应不同的搬运需求。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4a7e19ef14d3c072.en: For example, Tin Cable has a loss of 1. Across a 4-block cable connected to a Basic Combustion Generator, the voltage at the end is only 28EU/t, which is less than the 30EU/t required by typical LV machines. As a result, a working machine may lose power after a few seconds.

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4a7e19ef14d3c072.zh: 但是在这里无需担心，如果你浏览任务书，你会发现前期有便宜的超导，后面有无线，从而完全避开这个问题。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4ab25c15f0b05aa0.zh: 手持终端&6潜行右键多方块主机&r可以自动搭建多方块结构，如果是&d空手&r则会显示预览

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4ab25c15f0b05aa0.en: The Terminal can recognize blocks inside Sophisticated Backpacks that are &bnot in your Curios slot&r
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4ab25c15f0b05aa0.zh: 终端可以识别&b不在饰品栏中&r的精妙背包内的方块

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4ab25c15f0b05aa0.en: Auto-building has some quirks, especially in Creative mode; keeping functional hatches out of your inventory so it only places structural blocks first, then placing the functional hatches manually afterward, is recommended
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4ab25c15f0b05aa0.zh: 自动搭建有一点问题，特别是在创造模式，推荐先不要在背包中放功能仓室只放结构方块，在搭建出主体结构后再手动放上功能仓室

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4af1d57be5c49b3e.en: Use this to extract fluids from bedrock fluid veins
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4af1d57be5c49b3e.zh: 利用这个东西从虚空流体矿脉中采流体

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4af1d57be5c49b3e.en: Sneak + Right-Click with a Prospector's Scanner to switch to fluid vein mode
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4af1d57be5c49b3e.zh: 探矿仪潜行右键可以切换为流体矿脉模式

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4af1d57be5c49b3e.en: The depletion rate indicates how fast each recipe operation reduces the bedrock fluid vein's reserves
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4af1d57be5c49b3e.zh: 损耗率的数值代表着每次执行配方会减少虚空流体矿脉的储量的速度

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4af1d57be5c49b3e.en: Even if the Prospector's Scanner shows 0 for a bedrock fluid vein, drilling in that chunk will still yield a tiny amount of fluid
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4af1d57be5c49b3e.zh: 即使探矿仪显示虚空流体矿脉为0，在此区块钻取仍然会有极少量流体产出

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4b6f43302e963f5e.en: Primary material of the Steam Age

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4b7b7ea38b836f96.en: Sneak + Right-Click an AE &6ME Wireless Access Point&r to bind it to your ME Network (or place it inside the Wireless Access Point slot directly), allowing it to pull building materials straight from your ME Network inventory
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4b7b7ea38b836f96.zh: 可以潜行右键AE的&6无线访问点&r绑定ME网络（你直接放进去也行），从而直接调用ME网络库存物品

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4b7b7ea38b836f96.en: Avoid &crotating&r structures when using the Cut Paste Gadget, as doing so may cause blocks to lose part of their NBT data
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4b7b7ea38b836f96.zh: 在使用剪切工具时尽量&c不要旋转&r，否则会导致方块的部分nbt丢失

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4b7b7ea38b836f96.en: Wireless Energy / Dynamo / Laser Hatches placed or copied with these gadgets must be manually bound to the Wireless Energy Network by Right-Clicking them with a Data Stick, otherwise they will not interact with the Wireless Energy Network (leaving them unpowered or full)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4b7b7ea38b836f96.zh: 直接使用这些工具放置/复制的无线能源/动力/激光仓需要用闪存右键手动绑定无线电网，否则这些仓室不会与无线电网互动（即没电或者电满了）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4c943e88e3926a9a.en: Raw Coal can be used directly as fuel here
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4c943e88e3926a9a.zh: 在这里粗煤可以直接拿来当燃料用

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4dfdde01df6d6763.en: Convenient for walking through cables and pipes

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4ebcdd1e943f7350.en: See here for sources of Phosphorus
And here is the source of Manganese

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.en: In GregTech, each singleblock generator produces 1A of its voltage tier, but here the output amperage of singleblock generators has been significantly buffed.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.zh: 在格雷科技中，每个小发电机产生1A其电压等级，但是在这里小发电机的输出电流被大幅度加强了。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.en: If a machine needs 32EU/t, a 32EU "packet" is sent every tick.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.zh: 如果一个机器需要32EU/t，一个32EU的"包 "会每隔一tick发送。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.en: An LV Battery Buffer with 4 batteries can output 4A of LV (128EU/t).
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.zh: 一个带有4电池的LV电池箱可以产生4安培的LV(128EU/t)。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.en: General machines are configured to draw 2A, while other machines have specific amperage inputs described in their tooltips.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.zh: 通用机器被配置为抽取2安培，其他机器有特定的安培输入，这在它们的工具提示（tooltip）中描述。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.en: Attempting to transport more amps than the limit will burn your cables.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.zh: 试图运输超过限制的安培将会烧毁你的线缆。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.en: Amps are only drawn along cables directly connecting producers and consumers, and only while the consumer is running.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.zh: 安培只通过线缆直接连接生产者和消费者抽取，并且只在消费者运行时抽取。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.en: This means you can safely step down your cable thickness in certain places.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f7a3702787f86a7.zh: 这意味着你可以在某些地方安全地降低你的电缆粗细度。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.en: By default, press &6M&r to open the map, press &6T&r to teleport to the location under your cursor, and click the globe icon in the bottom-left corner to switch dimensions
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.zh: 默认&6M&r打开地图，按&6T&r可以传送至鼠标指向的地点，点击左下角的地球仪图标可以切换维度

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.en: In the top-left corner of the screen, you can claim and force-load chunks (claimed chunks are explosion-proof); on a server, setting the &6Forceload Mode&r to &balways&r in FTB Chunks server settings (purple gear icon) keeps force-loaded chunks loaded even when no players are online
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.zh: 界面左上角可以认领与强加载区块（认领的区块可以防爆）如果是在服务器，将ftb chunk的服务器设置（紫色齿轮）中的&6强制加载模式&r设置为&balways&r可以让服务器即使无人在线也可以让强加载区块加载

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.en: Hold the &6~&r key to use FTB Ultimine (vein mining)
Click the third button from the top in the top-right corner of the quest screen to view quest book hotkeys; press Ctrl+F to search quests by title, subtitle, description, task, or reward
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.zh: 在任务界面的右上角从上往下第三个按钮可以查看任务界面内的快捷键，ctrl+f可以通过任务标题/副标题/正文/目标/奖励搜索任务

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.en: Enter /sethome "name" to set a home waypoint, and /home "name" to teleport to it
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.zh: 输入/sethome “名字”可以设置传送点，输入/home “对应名字”传送至对应传送点

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.en: World backups can be found in the backup folder in your game root directory; enter /backup start to trigger an immediate backup
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.zh: 在游戏根目录的backup文件夹中可以找到存档备份，输入/backup start立刻进行一次备份

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.en: Flight inertia is disabled by default and can be toggled in the gtlcore config file
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.zh: 默认禁用了飞行惯性，可在gtlcore的配置文件中更改

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.en: If a GregTech version mismatch error appears in multiplayer, make sure the config files on the server and client are identical
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.zh: 如果联机时显示GregTech版本不匹配，请确保服务端和客户端的config文件保持一致

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.en: Block bloom is enabled by default and can be toggled in the gtlcore config file
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.zh: 默认开启方块泛光功能，可在gtlcore的配置文件中更改

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.en: More features can be configured in the config files
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.zh: 更多的功能可在配置文件中更改

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.en: More tips can be found in the &dTips \& Tricks chapter group&r
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4f864738509b6dca.zh: 更多的提示可在&d提示与技巧章节组&r查看

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.506dfa831febd175.en: Yields 4x as much when engraved compared to a regular Silicon Boule; requires an &6HV&r Laser Engraver to use
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.506dfa831febd175.zh: 蚀刻产量是普通单晶硅的4倍，有了&6HV&r激光蚀刻机后才能使用

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.516564dcea7fa80b.en: The Performance Monitor can measure the lag caused by all machines
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.516564dcea7fa80b.zh: 性能监控器可以监测所有机器造成的延迟

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.516564dcea7fa80b.en: Run /forge tps to check game tick time and try to keep TPS at a steady 20
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.516564dcea7fa80b.zh: 可以输入/forge tps来查看游戏延迟，最好保证tps一直处于20
以下事项可能是卡顿原因：

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.516564dcea7fa80b.en: Cramming everything into a small area. This won't hurt TPS, but will tank your FPS.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.516564dcea7fa80b.zh: 把所有东西都建在一个小空间内。这不会影响tps，但会导致fps下降。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.516564dcea7fa80b.en: Using large numbers of ME Import and Export Buses across your network. Using ME Interfaces is recommended instead.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.516564dcea7fa80b.zh: 在网络中大量使用输入和输出总线。推荐使用ME接口。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.516564dcea7fa80b.en: Requesting crafting jobs that dispatch tiny batches many times over. Reducing CPU dispatch parallelism and multiplying your patterns is recommended.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.516564dcea7fa80b.zh: 下单多次发配少量物品。建议减少CPU并行数，同时扩大样板倍数。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.518692429d15516b.en: Batch Mode can be enabled in the bottom-left corner of the machine UI; when enabled, it scales the recipe duration to get as close as possible to the value specified in the gtlcore config file
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.518692429d15516b.zh: 机器UI左下角可开启批处理模式，开启后在机器触发会让配方时长尽可能达到gtlcore配置文件内指定的数值

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.518692429d15516b.en: Batch Mode does not affect machine efficiency in most cases, but enabling it can effectively relieve performance pressure
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.518692429d15516b.zh: 批处理在大部分情况下不影响机器的工作效率，但开启后可以有效缓解性能压力

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.518692429d15516b.en: Batch Mode cannot be enabled on generators or cross-recipe parallel machines
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.518692429d15516b.zh: 批处理不能在发电机以及跨配方并行的机器上启用

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.518692429d15516b.en: You can toggle whether new machines have Batch Mode enabled or disabled by default in the gtlcore config file
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.518692429d15516b.zh: 可在gtlcore配置文件中切换新机器默认开启/关闭批处理模式

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.51b9a72c19f84f0e.en: If this is your first time playing, browsing the Electricity and Machines chapters as well is recommended
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.51b9a72c19f84f0e.zh: 第一次玩建议额外浏览《电力》《机器》这两个章节

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.525ed642c7a365d1.en: You no longer need to worry about the dark

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.527e9200ecb4a732.en: Switch modes in the top-left corner of the Pattern Modifier GUI: Multiply Mode (multiply/divide pattern amounts), Replace Mode (replace/insert/delete specific items in patterns), and Clone Mode (self-explanatory)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.527e9200ecb4a732.zh: 样板修改器在GUI左上角切换模式，分别为乘数模式（翻/除倍样板），替换模式（替换/插入/删除样板里面的特定物品），复制模式（字面意思）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.527e9200ecb4a732.en: The Provider version only has Multiply Mode, and also works on &bME Pattern Buffers&r
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.527e9200ecb4a732.zh: 供应器版只有乘数模式，也可以用于&b样板总成&r

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.529cfb9da52d4930.en: Now you can craft Wireless Energy / Dynamo Hatches
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.529cfb9da52d4930.zh: 可以制作无线能源/动力仓了

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.52a0ee026a3d3a79.en: Wrought Iron is a low-carbon iron alloy with better properties than regular Iron
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.52a0ee026a3d3a79.zh: 锻铁是低碳的铁合金，比铁性能更好

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.52a0ee026a3d3a79.en: Right now you can only get Wrought Iron by smelting Iron Nuggets into Wrought Iron Nuggets; once you have an Arc Furnace, you can make Wrought Iron Ingots directly from Iron Ingots or even Iron Blocks with Oxygen
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.52a0ee026a3d3a79.zh: 你现在只能通过烧铁粒获得锻铁粒从而获得锻铁，有了电弧炉可以直接用铁锭甚至铁块和氧气制作锻铁锭

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.52bc9be1e6301e6f.en: A View Cell that filters by tags
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.52bc9be1e6301e6f.zh: 显示元件，但是按照标签工作

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.535d45580fbde02b.en: After upgrading to the HV version, it can also engrave low-quality gems into high-quality gems
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.535d45580fbde02b.zh: 升级到HV版本之后还可以将低品质宝石蚀刻成高品质宝石

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.541275bc83188f74.en: Most minerals can be electrolyzed in MV
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.541275bc83188f74.zh: 大部分的矿物在MV都可以进行电解

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.541275bc83188f74.en: You can now obtain Aluminium Dust and Silicon Dust by electrolyzing Clay Dust; Diorite is rich in Clay
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.541275bc83188f74.zh: 你现在可以通过电解黏土粉获得铝粉和硅粉，闪长岩富含黏土

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5531507e2fa738a4.en: You can enable the &bPrimitive Void Miner&r in the gtlcore config file, which consumes Steam in the Overworld / Nether / End to randomly produce raw ores from that dimension
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5531507e2fa738a4.zh: 在gtlcore的配置文件中可以启用&b原始虚空采矿机&r，在主世界/下界/末地消耗蒸汽随机产出对应维度的粗矿

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5535934109a12b5d.en: Overclocking is a mechanic that occurs when you run a recipe in a machine of a higher power tier than the recipe itself; the recipe uses more energy, but its duration is reduced according to how many tiers you overclock.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5535934109a12b5d.zh: 超频是一种机制，当你试图在一个比配方本身更高功率的机器中运行配方时发生，配方将使用更多的能量，但配方时间将根据你超频的等级减少。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5535934109a12b5d.en: Some machines have a side menu to set the maximum voltage tier they can overclock to; click it to cycle through available voltages and select a limit.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5535934109a12b5d.zh: 某些机器有一个侧面菜单来设置它能超频到的最大电压等级，点击它来循环所有可用的电压并选择一个限制。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5535934109a12b5d.en: Every 4x power supplied above the recipe power allows one overclock. Each overclock means: 2x recipe speed, 4x power consumption, and 2x total energy cost, known as &bimperfect overclocking&r. Most machines use imperfect overclocking.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5535934109a12b5d.zh: 提供的功率每高于配方功率的四倍允许一次超频。每次超频意味着：2x配方速度，4x电力消耗，2x总能量成本，称为&b有损超频&r。大部分机器使用的都是有损超频。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5535934109a12b5d.en: However, ULV recipes (even 2EU/t Macerator recipes) do not overclock in LV machines, so they won't use LV-tier power until MV (Macerator recipes generally don't use 32EU/t until HV).
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5535934109a12b5d.zh: 但是ULV配方(乃至2EU/t的研磨机配方)在LV机器中不会超频，所以它们到MV才会使用LV等级的电功率(研磨机配方一般得到HV才使用32EU/t)。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5535934109a12b5d.en: Correspondingly, there is &dperfect overclocking&r: 4x recipe speed, 4x power consumption, and 1x total energy cost.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5535934109a12b5d.zh: 对应的有&d无损超频&r的概念，4x配方速度，4x电力消耗，1x总能量成本。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.575a2a1e4f56ff34.en: Hover your cursor over an item! (In your inventory, the right-hand search panel, or JEI)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.575a2a1e4f56ff34.zh: 鼠标移动到一个物品上面!（背包，右侧搜索栏，jei中）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.575a2a1e4f56ff34.en: Once the recipe screen opens, there are two rows with arrows at the top:
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.575a2a1e4f56ff34.zh: 打开界面后上面有两个带箭头的行

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.575a2a1e4f56ff34.en: The first row, like the tabs along the very top, switches between crafting categories/machines (click the text in this row to view all recipes for that machine)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.575a2a1e4f56ff34.zh: 第一行和最上的图标一样可以切换合成工具（点击这一行的文字可以查看这种方式的所有合成表）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.575a2a1e4f56ff34.en: The second row flips through pages (many items have numerous crafting methods—browse through them carefully)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.575a2a1e4f56ff34.zh: 第二行可以翻页（很多物品有大量的合成方法，请仔细浏览）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.575a2a1e4f56ff34.en: With gtlcore's tweaks, items sharing the same tag in JEI are grouped into a single slot; you can configure which tags are or aren't grouped in the gtlcore config
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.575a2a1e4f56ff34.zh: 在gtlcore的修改下jei的同标签物品会被合并到同一个位置里，在gtlcore的配置中具体调整哪些标签可/不可合并

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.58723da3e76316e6.en: Two regular Energy Hatches provide 4A of power, but they also step up the recipe tier, requiring higher-tier singleblock machines in multiblocks like the General Purpose Factory
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.58723da3e76316e6.zh: 2个普通能源仓有4A功率，但会将配方等级提升，从而导致如通用工厂机器需要更高级的小机器来运行

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.58723da3e76316e6.en: However, if you only place a single 4A Energy Hatch, the machine increases its power without stepping up the recipe tier—allowing a General Purpose Factory to run at HV speed using MV singleblock machines. gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.en: Running 16 LV machines simultaneously uses the same power as a single HV machine, but is four times as fast. This is because the 16 LV machines do not suffer the efficiency loss from imperfect overclocking, allowing them to get more done despite running slower individually.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.zh: 将16台LV机器同时运行，功率与一台HV机器相等，但是速度是一台HV机器的四倍。这是因为16台LV机器没有发生有损超频带来的损失。导致它以更低的速度做得更快。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.en: Multiblock parallelism is a similar concept. Simply put, parallelism is an alternative form of perfect overclocking.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.zh: 多方块结构的并行便是这么一种类似的概念。简单来说，并行就是一种另类的无损超频。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.en: Sub-tick parallelism (1toc) is a mechanic triggered by certain multiblocks when processing a single recipe takes less than 1 game tick.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.zh: 次刻并行（1toc），是部分多方块结构处理单个配方时用时小于 1 游戏刻时会触发的机制。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.en: No singleblock machines or cross-recipe parallel machines will trigger 1toc.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.zh: 所有单方块机器以及跨配方并行机器都不会触发1toc。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.en: Example 1: When a LuV-tier multiblock processes an IV-tier recipe that takes exactly 1 game tick, it will process 2 recipes per game tick; if the machine's voltage tier is one tier higher (reaching ZPM), it will process 4 recipes per game tick. If the machine has perfect overclocking (such as the Large Chemical Reactor), it will process 4 and 16 recipes in parallel at LuV and ZPM respectively.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.zh: 例 1：某 LuV 电压等级的多方块机器在处理 IV 电压等级时用时恰好为 1 游戏刻的配方时，该机器会每游戏刻处理 2 个配方，如果该机器电压等级再高一级（达到 ZPM 等级）则会每游戏刻处理 4 个配方；如果该机器有无损超频机制（如大型化学反应釜）则分别在 LuV 和 ZPM 等级并行处理 4 个和 16 个配方。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.en: Example 2: For a recipe that takes 3 game ticks with perfect overclocking (each overclock tier reduces duration to 1/4 while keeping total energy cost unchanged), overclocking by one tier will process 4 recipes simultaneously while keeping the duration at 3 game ticks.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.zh: 例 2：对于用时为 3 游戏刻的配方时且该配方为无损超频（每超一级用时减少为原来的 1/4，总能耗不变），超频一级后会同时处理 4 个配方，但用时仍然为 3 游戏刻。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.en: Cross-recipe parallelism is a mechanic exclusive to certain multiblock machines, allowing the machine to execute multiple different recipes under the same machine mode simultaneously.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.zh: 跨配方并行是部分多方块机器专属的机制，可以使机器同时执行在同一个机器模式下的多个不同配方。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.en: Correspondingly, the minimum duration for cross-recipe parallel machines is 1 second
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.zh: 对应的，跨配方并行机器的运行时间下限是1秒

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.en: Example: The Holy Separator can craft Silver Rods and Iron Rods simultaneously, but cannot centrifuge Air and craft Iron Rods at the same time.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.zh: 例：神圣分离者可以同时制作银杆和铁杆，但是不能同时离心空气和制作铁杆。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6f503441c24abd5b.en: "Threads" is a unique attribute of machines with cross-recipe parallelism (all have 64 threads). The total parallelism of a cross-recipe parallel machine equals the thread count multiplied by the machine's own parallelism, and the thread count represents the maximum number of recipes the total parallelism can be distributed across. Note: Cross-recipe parallel machines will allocate as much of their total parallelism as possible to a single recipe.

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7ce50c6425020dd4.en: If a machine running a chanced recipe has parallelism, the chanced outputs/inputs follow the expected value
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7ce50c6425020dd4.zh: 若运行概率配方的机器带有并行，则概率产出/消耗符合期望

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7ce50c6425020dd4.en: Voltage-scaling chances are calculated from the difference between the machine's maximum recipe tier and the lowest recipe voltage tier in JEI; chances stop scaling once the maximum recipe tier reaches MAX, and if a chance exceeds 100%, the output/input amount is increased
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7ce50c6425020dd4.zh: 随电压变动的概率以机器的最大配方等级与JEI中的最低配方电压等级的差来计算，最大配方等级至MAX后不再变动概率，若概率超过100%则会增加产出/消耗

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7f97bed1b9552e5e.en: The energy system in GregTech is far less simple than those in other tech mods.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7f97bed1b9552e5e.zh: 格雷科技中的能量系统远不如其他科技模组的能量系统那么简单。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7f97bed1b9552e5e.en: GregTech's energy unit is EU, distinct from the FE used by other mods.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7f97bed1b9552e5e.zh: 格雷科技的能量单位是EU，区别与其他模组使用的FE。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7f97bed1b9552e5e.en: Resistance is simulated in GregTech as cable loss
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7f97bed1b9552e5e.zh: 电阻在格雷科技中模拟为电缆损耗

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7f97bed1b9552e5e.en: - EU is the unit of energy.

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7f97bed1b9552e5e.zh: - V(伏)是电压，游戏中称为LV, MV, HV...因为这些是游戏玩法相关的值(技术上:LV = 32V = 32EU/t/A)。
